description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510600
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels in Kalalpitiya and Ellakkala villages. It includes detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, extents, and property rights, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
